message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 20, "var": "nbytes/cbytes/blocksize", "code": "blosc_cbuffer_sizes(data, &nbytes, &cbytes, &blocksize);", "note": "Parses the attacker-controlled blosc header. For this input cbytes==size==54 and nbytes==54, so the fuzzer proceeds past the size checks."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 32, "var": "output", "code": "output = malloc(cbytes);", "note": "Allocates a cbytes(54)-byte output buffer that is left UNINITIALIZED. This is the origin of the uninitialized value reported by MSAN."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_chunk.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 34, "var": "output", "code": "blosc2_decompress(data, size, output, cbytes);", "note": "Passes the uninitialized output buffer as the decompression destination with destsize=cbytes=54."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "blosc2_decompress", "line": 2227, "var": "dest", "code": "result = blosc_run_decompression_with_context(g_global_context, src, srcsize, dest, destsize);", "note": "Routes the uninitialized dest buffer into the decompression pipeline."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "blosc_d", "line": 1060, "var": "_dest", "code": "_dest = dest + dest_offset;", "note": "Header flags are 0x60 (ZLIB format, no shuffle/bitshuffle/delta), so last_filter_index<0 and _dest points directly into the uninitialized output buffer."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "blosc_d", "line": 1072, "var": "neblock", "code": "neblock = bsize / nstreams;", "note": "typesize=32 so nstreams=32; bsize=54, giving neblock=1. The decompressor is told the output block is only 1 byte."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "blosc_d", "line": 1079, "var": "cbytes", "code": "cbytes = sw32_(src);", "note": "Reads the per-stream compressed size token (16) from the input; the compressed zlib stream is 16 bytes."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "blosc_d", "line": 1130, "var": "nbytes", "code": "nbytes = zlib_wrap_decompress((char*)src, (size_t)cbytes, (char*)_dest, (size_t)neblock);", "note": "compformat==BLOSC_ZLIB_FORMAT, so the 16-byte zlib stream is decompressed into the 1-byte uninitialized _dest buffer."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "blosc/blosc2.c", "function": "zlib_wrap_decompress", "line": 461, "var": "output/maxout", "code": "status = uncompress((Bytef*)output, &ul, (Bytef*)input, (uLong)compressed_length);", "note": "Calls zlib uncompress with maxout=ul=neblock=1, writing into the uninitialized output buffer."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "internal-complibs/miniz-2.0.8/miniz.c", "function": "mz_uncompress", "line": 543, "var": "stream.next_out", "code": "status = mz_inflate(&stream, MZ_FINISH);", "note": "stream.next_out points to the uninitialized output buffer with avail_out=1."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "internal-complibs/miniz-2.0.8/miniz.c", "function": "mz_inflate", "line": 444, "var": "pOut_buf_next", "code": "status = tinfl_decompress(&pState->m_decomp, pStream->next_in, &in_bytes, pStream->next_out, pStream->next_out, &out_bytes, decomp_flags);", "note": "MZ_FINISH on first call sets TINFL_FLAG_USING_NON_WRAPPING_OUTPUT_BUF; tinfl_decompress reads from the uninitialized output buffer while inflating the 16-byte stream into the 1-byte buffer."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "internal-complibs/miniz-2.0.8/miniz.c", "function": "tinfl_decompress", "line": 2719, "var": "pSrc", "code": "pOut_buf_cur[0] = pSrc[0];", "note": "During LZ77 back-reference copy, pSrc points into the output buffer region that was never written (uninitialized malloc memory); reading it is the use-of-uninitialized-value that MSAN reports at miniz.c:444."}
]
EOF
echo "written"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json, steps:', len(d))"` executed with exit code 0.
